List<Combatant> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatantRows = query(\"SELECT name, score, dex, roll FROM combatants WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"dex\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"roll\"))));\n            }\n\n            CombatSession session = new CombatSession((String) sessionRow.get(\"id\"), combatants);\n            session.round = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"round\"));\n            session.turnIndex = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"turn_index\"));\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> conditionRows List<Combatant> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatantRows = query(\"SELECT name, score, dex, roll FROM combatants WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \"    session.round = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"round\"));\n            session.turnIndex = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"turn_index\"));\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> conditionRows
